subject: Life Skills
title: Handling Food You Dislike
description: A quick, practical guide to Handling Food You Dislike.

hook.text: Your host proudly serves a dish you cannot stand. Refusing feels rude. Forcing it feels worse.

buildup.text: In many cultures, rejecting food insults the cook. The dish often carries hours of effort and tradition.

discovery.text: Take a small portion and eat slowly. Most hosts care that you tried, not that you cleaned the plate.

twist.text: Allergies are different. State them early and clearly. No polite host wants to send you to the hospital.

climax.text: Thank the host for the meal, not the specific dish. 'This was wonderful' covers everything graciously.

punchline.text: A small taste shows big respect.

quiz.question: How should you handle a dish you dislike at someone's home?
options: Take a small portion and eat some of it
Hide it under other food on your plate
